body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.33 (naive sector base rate 0.47) that: Endurance starts SOP of 4W driveshafts for Tata Motors by 31-Dec-2026. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.47 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=13); SAC -43.0 pts x weight 0.31 (N=9) -> p = 0.33. Evidence: Q1FY27 call (14-Aug-2026): 'SOP for Tata Motors is expected also in the next quarter'; Q2FY27 (04-Nov-2026): 'expected in this quarter'. Endurance SOP record: dual-channel ABS 13 months late; Chennai brakes Q2FY27 -> Mar-2027; Bajaj SOP Q2 -> Q4; Chinese OEM Q1 -> Q3. Resolution: YES if the Q3 FY27 call/presentation (or an NSE filing) states that 4W driveshaft supplies/SOP for Tata Motors started on or before 31-Dec-2026. Started in Jan-2027 or later, or not mentioned by the Q3 call = NO. Source: Endurance Q3 FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.47 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=13); SAC -43.0 pts x weight 0.31 (N=9) -> p = 0.33
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'capacity' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=13). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the Q3 FY27 call/presentation (or an NSE filing) states that 4W driveshaft supplies/SOP for Tata Motors started on or before 31-Dec-2026. Started in Jan-2027 or later, or not mentioned by the Q3 call = NO.
data.resolution_source: Endurance Q3 FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE)
